topic.label: Derivatives
topic.desc: Derivatives: Options, Pricing and Greeks, Hedging Strategies, Futures and Forwards and Swaps.

concepts.label: Futures and Forwards
concepts.desc: Futures and forward contracts, margin, contango and backwardation, and roll.

concepts.label: Hedging Strategies
concepts.desc: Using derivatives to hedge: protective puts, collars, futures hedges and delta hedging.

concepts.label: Options
concepts.desc: Calls and puts, strikes and expiries, intrinsic and time value, and options chains.

concepts.label: Pricing and Greeks
concepts.desc: Black-Scholes and binomial pricing, implied volatility and the Greeks.

concepts.label: Swaps
concepts.desc: Interest rate swaps, credit default swaps, currency swaps and total return swaps.

skills.label: Futures Roll Explainer
skills.desc: Explains futures roll, contango and backwardation and their cost.

skills.label: Hedge Designer
skills.desc: Designs a hedge for an exposure and compares cost and residual risk.

skills.label: Option Payoff Builder
skills.desc: Builds the payoff and break-even for an option or multi-leg options strategy.

skills.label: Options Chain Reader
skills.desc: Reads an options chain and explains open interest, implied volatility and skew.

skills.label: Option Pricer
skills.desc: Prices a call or put option and computes its Greeks with Black-Scholes and states the assumptions.

skills.label: Swap Valuation Explainer
skills.desc: Explains how a swap's legs are valued and what moves its value.

mcp.desc: Polygon.io MCP server: market data for stocks, options, indices, forex and crypto, aggregates, trades, quotes, reference data and financials.
